question_text: SUPREME COURT is to JUDICIARY as CONGRESS is to ___?

hint_ladder.title: Tatlong Sangay
hint_ladder.text: Alam mo ba ang tatlong branch? Executive, Legislative, Judicial. Supreme Court nasa Judiciary. Congress sa'n kaya? Isip ka ng barangay.

hint_ladder.title: Congress = Tagagawa ng Batas
hint_ladder.text: Sa Tagalog, legislative ay tagagawa ng batas. Ang Congress ang gumagawa ng batas, kaya Legislative branch siya. Parang Sangguniang Barangay.

hint_ladder.title: Relasyon: Institution to Branch
hint_ladder.text: Ang pattern: Institution (Supreme Court, Congress) -> Branch (Judiciary, Legislative). Tandaan mo 'to para sa exam!

hint_ladder.title: Sagot: Legislative
hint_ladder.text: Kaya sagot ay 'Legislative' dahil Congress ang legislative body, gaya ng Supreme Court sa judicial. Kaya mo 'yan!

A.text: You might have chosen A because you thought Congress executes laws, but that's the President's branch; trap: jurisdiction_misattribution.

B.text: Correct. Congress is the legislative branch, tasked with making laws under the Constitution.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you reversed the relationship, thinking Congress is judicial like courts, but it's not.

D.text: You might have chosen D because 'Constitutional' sounds official, but it's not a branch; trap: unqualified_generalization.

next_time_rule: Tatandaan: Executive = President, Legislative = Congress, Judicial = Supreme Court. Institution to branch ang relasyon.
deconstruct_text:
Governing Rule: The 1987 Constitution structures the government into three branches: Legislative (Congress, Art. VI, Sec. 1), Executive (President), and Judicial (Supreme Court). Each institution belongs to its branch.

Isipin mo, parang sa barangay: Si Kapitan (Executive) nagpapatupad ng ordinansa, pero ang Sangguniang Barangay (Legislative) ang gumagawa nito. Sa national level, Congress ang gumagawa ng batas, kaya Legislative branch.

Step-by-step: 1. Supreme Court -> Judiciary. 2. Congress -> Legislative. 3. 'Legislative' ang tamang sagot. 4. 'Executive' at 'Judicial' ay ibang branch; 'Constitutional' ay hindi branch.

Why Distractors Fail: A (Executive) – akala mo Congress nag-e-execute, pero President 'yon. C (Judicial) – akala mo korte ang Congress. D (Constitutional) – hindi branch ang salitang 'yan.
